policy.purpose: Point 5 acceptance: typed counterfactual scope -> CounterfactualGoal -> existing CounterfactualContext sandbox.
invariants: GoalCompiler never recognizes counterfactuals from surface marker words.
HYPOTHETICAL assumptions are not ordinary factual premises.
A direct polar counterfactual query gets one EMBEDDED addressable target with occurrence_count=0.
Independent sibling assumptions enter one CounterfactualContext simultaneously.
Nested content below a hypothetical assumption is not mistaken for the query target.
Counterfactual proof does not mutate canonical AH or materialize its conclusion.
Positive and negative local overrides disappear when the counterfactual scope ends.
Incompatible simultaneous assumptions stop as CONFLICTED.
Open-ended FILL_ROLE and structural RelationGoal counterfactual targets fail closed.
Quoted hypothetical edges do not create a counterfactual scope.
Ordinary non-counterfactual query dispatch remains unchanged.
